name: Credentials via Executa
description: Exposes list_accounts / token_info / gmail_recent tools that wrap the host credentials/listAccounts + credentials/getToken reverse-RPCs, letting the Credentials Demo app read multi-account platform authorizations — and fetch recent Gmail messages with the exchanged token — through an Executa instead of calling anna.credentials.* directly.
_comment: Dev-path locator only (`active: local`) — this demo has no binary profile yet; add one alongside a GitHub Release when needed (see anna-app-llm-demo for the multi-profile form). This dir is the `credentials-via-executa` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas.
